description: Bike + Ride Anlagen Hamburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Transparenzportal Hamburg. Der Datensatz enthält die Lage der Fahrradabstellanlagen an Schnellbahnhaltestellen im Hamburger Stadtgebiet. Für jede Abstellanlage wird die Anzahl der öffentlichen Stellplätze (überdacht und nicht überdacht) und, wenn vorhanden, die Anzahl der abschließbaren Mietplätze angegeben. Coverage: Transparenzportal Hamburg. The portal files it under the publisher Transparenzportal Hamburg. Its tags are b-plus-r, bahn, bike, bike-plus-ride, fahrradabstellplätze-an-s-und-u-bahn-haltestellen. It offers 12 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/GML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, OAF, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
